top_signals.title: City law firm to rebrand after co-founder demands name be stripped
top_signals.summary: The co-founder of a City-based law firm behind the largest group claim in UK history against mining giant BHP said he will file a cease-and-desist to have his name removed after the firm initiated legal action against its own clients in the claim.
